profile.headline: Principal Systems/Software Engineer at HPE
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer VII at Hewlett Packard Enterprise
profile.summary:
With 16+ years dedicated to data storage engineering, I am a Principal Engineer passionate about building the resilient and performant infrastructure that underpins modern IT. My expertise spans virtualization, compute, networking, and data protection, with a recent focus on creating robust, cloud-native storage solutions.

As a technical lead at HPE, I have been instrumental in:
▪️ Architecting for Kubernetes: Leveraging extensive K8s expertise to design and implement a control plane for data sharding. This included evaluating K8s for our product line, customizing the scheduler, and engineering solutions that harness its full potential.
▪️ Modernizing File Services: Leading the integration of the user-space NFS Ganesha server into our data path stack and designing the provisioning service to create and export filesystems.
▪️ Advanced Data Protection: Architecting and leading the development of fanout replication for block storage, enabling complex, multi-site synchronous and asynchronous replication topologies.

As a Software Engineer at Netapp, my contributions comprised of:
▪️Architected and led the design of the vVols Vendor Provider (VP) High Availability and Disaster Recovery solution, a critical component of NetApp’s VMware integration strategy.
▪️Engineered a novel vVol placement algorithm and a ZAPI throttling mechanism for clustered Data ONTAP, leveraging Data ONTAP Headroom and WAFL performance metrics to optimize provisioning.
▪️Championed NetApp's virtualization solutions as a technical expert and presenter at VMworld (2014 & 2015); developed and delivered technical training on vVols to the global support organization.
▪️Developed key components of the Virtual Storage Console (VSC), a vSphere plugin for NetApp storage management, and the Mbralign tool to resolve VM partition misalignment issues.


I lead with empathy and a commitment to collaboration, whether I'm working with my development team, partnering with product management, or diving into complex field issues with the support organization. My technical toolkit is rooted in languages like C++ and Golang and technologies like Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and the full spectrum of storage protocols .

I am a hands-on engineer proficient in C++, Golang, C, and Rust, with a deep understanding of tools like GDB, vTune, and Address Sanitizers for performance tuning and debugging. As a holder of multiple patents, I am driven to innovate and solve the most demanding challenges in data storage.

patents.title: Recovery support techniques for storage virtualization environments
Transfer of synchronous and asynchronous replication
patents.description: In some examples, a first storage system receives a transfer of a synchronous replication role and an asynchronous replication role of a second storage system to the first storage system, where in the synchronous replication role the second storage system is to synchronously replicate data to the first storage system, and in the asynchronous replication role the second storage system is to asynchronously replicate a first data storage object to a third storage system. The first storage system uses, at the first storage system, translation information to identify a second data storage object that the second storage system is to asynchronously replicate to the third storage system following the transfer.
